label: Cleaning
headline_template: Leaves the place ready for company.

services.name: House cleaning
services.what: The regular clean — floors, baths, kitchen surfaces, dust.
services.benefit: The house stays livable without you spending the weekend on it.

services.name: Move-out cleans
services.what: Empty-house clean so a landlord or buyer can walk it.
services.benefit: A better shot at the deposit or a listing that doesn’t smell like the last tenant.

services.name: Kitchens and baths
services.what: Grease, grout, and the rooms that make or break a walkthrough.
services.benefit: The two rooms people judge first actually look handled.

services.name: Small offices
services.what: A shop, suite, or small office that needs emptying of trash and a real floor clean.
services.benefit: Clients walk into a place that looks open, not abandoned.

services.name: Recurring visits
services.what: A set day so the same mess doesn’t pile up for a month.
services.benefit: You stop negotiating “when can you come” every time.

services.name: One-time deep cleans
services.what: The reset after a party, a renovation, or a long skip.
services.benefit: Start from clean, then keep it with a lighter visit.

process.title: You call the shop
process.body: The number on this page rings them. Say if it’s a one-time clean, a move-out, or a regular visit.

process.title: They tell you if they can take it
process.body: Ask if they cover your street, what’s included, and whether you need to be home.

process.title: They look, then they talk
process.body: For a first visit they should confirm rooms and extras (oven, fridge, inside windows) before they start.

faqs.q: How do I know I need a cleaning crew?
faqs.a: A move-out that has to pass inspection, a kitchen you can’t get back, or a schedule that doesn’t leave a Saturday for it.

faqs.q: What should I do while I wait?
faqs.a: Clear counters if you can. Lock up jewelry and cash. Say if pets will be home.
